lookback_summary: What a weekend it was! The model really came through with some solid calls, nailing the Fulham vs Man United draw and predicting Newcastle's convincing win over Hull as a banker. However, I had to eat humble pie on the Leeds vs Crystal Palace match, where I thought a home win was likely but ended up with a dull draw instead. And who could have seen Brighton taking down Arsenal so decisively? It's a tough league, and this weekend was a real rollercoaster!
